## 验证对象 / Subject

中文：
English:

完整 commit SHA、章节、日期与环境 / Full commit SHA, chapters, date, and environment:
证据类型：作者推演、独立文字评估、结构检查或真实产品操作 / Evidence type: author walkthrough, independent text evaluation, structural check, or real-product interaction:

## 方法与结果 / Method and results

| 案例 / Case | 输入与类别 / Input and category | 预期 / Expected | 实际 / Actual | 证据 / Evidence | 结论 / Verdict |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| | 正常、异常、信息不足、新边界或恢复 / Normal, exceptional, insufficient input, new boundary, or recovery | | | | |

旧新版对照：哪些输入、模型或判据保持一致，哪些改变 / Old/new comparison: which inputs, models, or criteria stayed fixed and which changed:

## 问题与下一步 / Findings and next action

中文：
English:

影响、建议条款和复验条件 / Impact, proposed clauses, and retest conditions:
未执行、未验证与证据限制 / NOT_RUN, UNVERIFIED, and evidence limitations:
关联 Issue 或 PR / Related issues or PRs:

<!-- 文字案例通过不代表真实产品验收；结构检查不代表事实、许可或全面安全认证。
